title: Solemn and Poetic Register: áldd meg, nyújts feléje

sections.title: Subjunctive / Imperative of Supplication in the Himnusz
sections.content: The Himnusz is a poetic prayer to God. You know the imperative from A2: *Isten, áldd meg a magyart!* ('God, bless the Hungarians!') has the definite imperative ending because of the definite object, and *Nyújts feléje védő kart!* ('Hold out a protecting arm towards them!') has the indefinite imperative.

items.spanish: A Himnusz nem harci induló, hanem a magyarok közös imája Istenhez.
items.english: The Himnusz is not a battle march but the shared prayer of the Hungarians to God.

items.spanish: Január 22-én, Kölcsey kéziratának befejezése napján ünnepeljük a magyar kultúra napját.
items.english: On January 22nd, the day Kölcsey finished his manuscript, we celebrate the Day of Hungarian Culture.
